hypotheses.name: Multiseed convexity-detour incremental value
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44, fit nested logistic models (geodesic+diffusion covariates vs +detour_ratio+convexity_deficit) on source/target disjoint splits and layers {0,3,7,11} with stratified feature-shuffle nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.00153 overall; significant Fisher delta in 2/6 domain-split groups
hypotheses.next_action: Stratify by biological prior tiers to test whether incremental gain concentrates in high-consensus regulatory edges.

hypotheses.name: Local-linearity depth breakpoint asymmetry
hypotheses.method: Computed per-layer edge AUROC from local reconstruction linearity scores, fit best piecewise depth breakpoints per domain/seed/split, and tested breakpoint/improvement against layer-order permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: external_lung shift +4.33 layers (p=0.0465); immune/lung shifts non-significant
hypotheses.next_action: Replicate external_lung breakpoint shift under dual-axis disjoint and bootstrap robustness checks.

hypotheses.name: Anchor-regularized utility spectral alignment
hypotheses.method: Built mixed PCA+spectral scGPT/Geneformer spaces on 240 shared symbols per domain, selected lambda by source-split utility, evaluated held-out target-split AUROC with TRRUST-source weighted Procrustes; compared against lambda=0 baseline, iter_0016 cycle baseline, random-anchor, and label-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.2008 mean target AUROC delta vs baseline; label-permutation significant in 3/3 domains; random-anchor null non-discriminative
hypotheses.next_action: Use anchor-dropout and anchor-mismatch utility controls to resolve anchor-specific attribution.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Cross-model branch is rescue-only after repeated inconclusive outcomes; this run used a materially changed utility-targeted method.
